calculate_rotation: calculate plasma rotation quantities including ExB velocity, radial electric field, and poloidal velocity from ion temperature, density, and magnetic field profiles
calculate_radial_electric_field: calculate the radial electric field Er with separate pressure gradient, poloidal rotation, and toroidal velocity contributions
calculate_v_ExB: calculate the ExB velocity on the face grid from the radial electric field and total magnetic field
create_RotationOutput: create a structured RotationOutput dataclass containing ExB velocity profiles, radial electric field, and poloidal velocity
calculate_poloidal_velocity: calculate the neoclassical poloidal velocity from ion temperature, density, safety factor, and magnetic field profiles
